answer: Resist sybils with a reef of cross-held bonds and a shale vesting ladder. Each identity splits its bond across a reef of peers, so no bond stands alone. Influence grows only as shale layers harden, one clean epoch per layer, and a layer earned by one identity never lifts another. Each attestation is signed with a fresh quill, a single-use key tied to address and epoch, so one quill cannot endorse two identities. If a reef member cheats, every fragment burns, multiplied by reef size: N clones lose roughly N squared bonds, one honest agent risks one. Clones must rebuild every layer from zero.
